'''Skorrupon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Skorrupon was the site of several notable battles: during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], and [[Deel Surool]] [[Battle of Skorrupon|intercepted]] [[High Inquisitor]] [[Volytar]]'s shuttle outside of his personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] over the world. The three thus became known as the Heroes of Skorrupon.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Later, in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces attempted to [[Battle of Skorrupon (Galactic Civil War)|ambush]] the newly christened [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] above Skorrupon, in one of the Rebellion's first encounters with the powerful [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The Rebel force was utterly [[Battle of Skorrupon (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]], with fleeing [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Vrad Dodonna]] the only survivor. Skorrupon was also [[Battle of the Skorrupon system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
